accuracy.definition: Exact answer match, including correct abstention, divided by all cases.

unsupported_assertion_rate.definition: Non-abstaining answers that disagree with the synthetic oracle divided by all non-abstaining answers.

evidence_consistency.definition: Answered outputs with at least one citation and all cited visible items matching that answer, divided by answered outputs; not a truth test.

retrieval_precision.definition: Correct cited oracle evidence IDs divided by unique cited IDs.

retrieval_recall.definition: Correct cited oracle evidence IDs divided by oracle evidence IDs; abstention cases have denominator zero.

appropriate_abstention.definition: Abstentions on unresolved cases divided by unresolved cases.

memory_fidelity.definition: Exact correctness on revision cases divided by revision cases.

error_recovery.definition: Exact correctness on recovery cases divided by recovery cases.

output_consistency.definition: Cases whose repeated semantic outputs match divided by unique cases with at least two repeats.

latency_ms.definition: Measured predict call elapsed time, excluding persistence and scoring.

confidence_calibration.reason: Targets do not provide validated probabilistic predictions.

uncertainty.reason: Descriptive census of fixed synthetic fixtures; repeated deterministic runs are not independent population samples.

resources.scope: Process RSS snapshots; not peak allocation or isolated target memory.
